tested_environment: KOMPAS-3D v25 Educational x64 25.0.0.2735 / Windows 11 / Python 3.12.10
known_limitations: Unfold supports selected ISheetMetalBend.Straighten, not a universal unfolding feature.
Assembly interference scan covers top-level components only.
Specification regrouping/update is explicit and limited to managed specifications created in the same session.
Component pattern creates explicit instances rather than a native parametric pattern feature.
No universal capability guarantee for complex geometry or other KOMPAS editions.
